script.text: Yugo figured out why Rin was not acting like herself.
I bet it's that Fusion Parasite that's doing a whack job on her! The old Rin would never use that slippery slug. She hates bugs!
This will wipe out all of your life points!
Rin! Don't go! Duel Academy are a bunch of losers!
Y' know, we're not ALL losers.
Does that mean you're with Duel Academy?
Relax, pal. The name's Aster Phoenix. I'm pals with Yuya.
Your name's Yugo, right? Did you have any luck finding that girl named, what was it, Gin? Min?
Rin! The name's Rin! And yeah, I found her. Except she's not the same person that I used to know.
That's because she's being mind controlled. And she's not the only one. Shay's sister Lulu too.
